profile_text.body:
Microsoft Research is the research lab of Microsoft, headquartered in Redmond, WA, USA. According to its own site, it conducts fundamental science and technology research across a spectrum of areas, with labs around the globe, and pursues breakthroughs across the computing and AI stack to accelerate discovery across sciences and advance the frontiers of computing and AI. The site lists research areas including artificial intelligence, search and information retrieval, human language technologies, human-computer interaction, computer vision, graphics and multimedia, and audio and acoustics. It also features publications, products, downloads, and research careers.

The lab is recorded as a for-profit research organization, and it is also known as MSR. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its recorded location falls in Washington, where 114 cases are tracked in the site's litigation records.
